business.title: Open a tab for a table
business.goal: Start an order tab for an available restaurant table.

steps.title: Find an available table
steps.description: Find the table that will receive the new tab.

steps.title: Check table availability
steps.description: Confirm the selected table is available for service.

steps.title: Open the tab
steps.description: Create an open tab for the selected table and mark the table as occupied.

outcome.statement: An open tab is associated with the selected table.
evidence: The tab is identified as open.
The table is shown as occupied.

business.title: Add a menu item to an open tab
business.goal: Record an ordered menu item with its quantity and optional note.

steps.title: Find the open tab
steps.description: Use the tab already in hand or find the open tab for the table.

steps.title: Review the open tab
steps.description: Confirm the tab is open before adding an item.

steps.title: Find a menu item
steps.description: Find the requested item in the menu.

steps.title: Review item and price
steps.description: Check the selected menu item and its current price.

steps.title: Add the item to the tab
steps.description: Record the menu item on the open tab with its quantity and optional observation.

outcome.statement: The requested item is recorded on the open tab.
evidence: The tab lists the item, quantity, and any observation.
The tab total reflects the added item.

business.title: Cancel a mistaken tab item
business.goal: Remove an item entered by mistake while the tab remains open.

steps.title: Find the open tab
steps.description: Use the tab already in hand or find the open tab for the table.

steps.title: Confirm the tab is open
steps.description: Check that the tab is still open and its items can be corrected.

steps.title: Find the mistaken item
steps.description: Find the item that was entered by mistake on the tab.

steps.title: Review the item to cancel
steps.description: Verify the item selected for cancellation.

steps.title: Cancel the item
steps.description: Cancel the mistaken item from the open tab.

outcome.statement: The mistaken item is canceled and no longer contributes to the tab total.
evidence: The item is marked as canceled on the tab.

business.title: Close a tab and register payment
business.goal: Set an optional discount, register payment, close the tab, and release the table.

steps.title: Find the tab to close
steps.description: Use the tab already in hand or find the open tab for the table.

steps.title: Review the total
steps.description: Review the tab items and total before payment.

steps.title: Apply an optional discount
steps.description: Apply a discount to the tab when one is needed.

steps.title: Register payment and close the tab
steps.description: Record the payment method, close the tab, and release its table.

outcome.statement: Payment is recorded, the tab is closed, and the table is available again.
evidence: The payment method is recorded for the tab.
The tab is shown as closed.
The table is shown as available.
